---
name: Data correction
about: A wordlist entry, sign mapping, site coordinate, or other data point is wrong
labels: data
---

## What's wrong
The specific entry, mapping, or value you believe is incorrect. Quote the
exact line if you can find it.

## What it should be
Your proposed correction.

## Source
Cite the publication or authoritative source that supports your correction.
For comparison-language entries, please cite the dictionary or grammar.
For sign mappings, include the inscriptions that motivate the change.
